name: The /desk briefing page
notes: UPDATED (one snapshot per date) by developer: Screen History is now a year-at-a-glance calendar, not a table -- the backend settles exactly one snapshot per screen date (app/research/desk_screen_decision.py), so the near-duplicate same-date rows the table existed to tell apart no longer exist. This step's `desk-history-table` / 'date' header pin retargets to the calendar's own container and its statically-rendered 'Jan' month label -- a shell string present in the first paint, deliberately NOT async-list or <option> text (the era-5 headless-matcher lesson).

UPDATED (desk section collapse) by developer: six /desk sections now render COLLAPSED -- Screen Runs, Screen Comparison, Provenance, Index Reconciliation, Top-up Runs and Playbook Evidence are on the page and named, but closed by default, and each one's own GET is deferred until its first expand. Their headings stay VISIBLE while closed, so a step that pins a section TITLE still resolves untouched; only a step reading a section's CONTENTS needs the expand click inserted before it, because the replay runner resolves every target with state="visible". This is a deliberate product-shape change, not a regression.
